title: fix(app-shell): draw the draft preview failure and empty panes with the shared view states
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97Yc9Hw7zbkBCZQmMnndL2D)_
Part of #25915

Clause-②: no (one surface swaps its own block for the shared components; no exported type change. If the shared component needs a new prop, the thread reports first and the seat amends this line)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Slice 1 of #25915: one surface moves onto the shared view states. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/PreviewDraftEmptyState.tsx` (the pane a `?preview=draft` tree shows when it has nothing to draw) no longer composes the bare `Empty` primitive:

- overlay read failed: `DataErrorState`, so it is `role="alert"`;
- app not in the draft yet, or nothing drafted: `DataEmptyState`, so it is `role="status"`.

Text (same i18n keys and default values), the Retry control (`preview-draft-retry`, glyph included) and the outer `preview-draft-empty-state` wrapper are unchanged. The title and icon take the shared components' sizes, which is the visual diff.

## Why this surface (measured on main 6d15acab)

app-shell defines six empty blocks of its own and imports `DataEmptyState` / `DataErrorState` zero times. Importers per block: `InspectorEmptyState` 7, `StudioEmptyState` 4, `PreviewEmptyState` 3, `AppNoAccessEmptyState` 2, `agentEmptyState` 1, `PreviewDraftEmptyState` 1.

`PreviewDraftEmptyState` is the only one of the six that draws a load **failure**, and it drew it as the same unlabelled node as its empty case, so a failed draft-overlay read was announced as nothing. The card's "route renderer catch paths to `DataErrorState`" lands exactly here. It has one importer (`AppContent.tsx`, not edited), is outside `ObjectView.tsx` and seat 2's packages, and no `claude/*` branch on origin touches it (depth-1 blob compare of all 707 heads against main; control file `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` differs on many). Non-`claude/*` branches were not scanned.

app-shell is outside the sdui registry closure: `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` byte-identical (922 files in 27 packages), so the record is not in the diff.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/PreviewDraftEmptyState.sharedStates-25915.test.tsx`: failure is `role="alert"` with `data-slot="data-error-state"` and no status; not-yet-drafted and nothing-drafted are `role="status"` with `data-slot="data-empty-state"` and no alert; one Retry control in each pane calls `onRetry`.

- Run at 250585bd: that file plus `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/draftBar-es-register-3844.test.ts` (which names this component), `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 15 passed (15)`.
- Ablation: with the fix committed, the source reverted to its main version, the new file reads `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)` (the three role tests red, the two Retry tests green as expected); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty and blob hash equal to HEAD.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after building `@object-ui/app-shell^...`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The rest of app-shell's blocks (`InspectorEmptyState`, `StudioEmptyState`, `PreviewEmptyState`, `AppNoAccessEmptyState`, `agentEmptyState`) stay for later slices; #25915 remains open.
- `DataErrorState`'s own `onRetry` button carries no glyph or test id, so this surface passes its existing Retry button as children rather than adding a prop to the shared component.
